purpose: Turn the verified controllable connection window into an observable, learnable service response without editing the failed v111 learner.
immediate_work: In a new isolated version, define the minimal action-conditioned service model and sample/label contract; establish whether existing records provide the required pre-action state. No additional same-root dose experiment.
base_policy: Freeze MC-WM actor, critic, V, temperature and original F. New proposed module is a mechanism change, not unchanged v111.
inputs: decision-time receiver load and free seats
decision-time nearby feeder position and current-stage destination
decision-time known compatible transfer intent only where available
hold after original F and native command application time
labels: actual feeder alighting and receiver boarding
new boarding count and its service dwell
timing: Freeze input at issue; admit outcome labels only after their logged events have matured. Keep noncompleted windows censored; never use future arrival time or offline trip intent as an unacknowledged input.
data: These exposed roots are mechanism cases, not a sufficient training or held-out test set. Check availability of inputs in existing records before specifying any additional collection budget. Do not fabricate missing pre-action positions from later events.
action_design: Use original F feasible actions; no passenger-ID/time-specific 7.5-second deployment rule and no dose tuning from these outcomes.
comparison: Same added observables, initial service module, decision rule and budget for fresh/no_fresh; only fresh may update the service module using causally matured feedback. Preserve same-actor frozen MC-WM as the second baseline.
admission: Freeze sample support, feedback budget, candidate selector and independent evaluation trajectories before training or deployment. Local connection accuracy is necessary evidence, never the performance gate.
final_cost_gate: Future deployed fresh must satisfy full-day fresh-minus-matched-no_fresh mean<0,stable<=0,shock<0; fresh-minus-same-actor-frozen<=0 per scenario and at least one<0. Early/tail descriptive. This one-root experiment does not establish the joint gate or reopen v111.
